scenarios.name: Select a source command without staging it from the Sketch panel

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software with Sketch1 being edited
a part document is in sketch edit in the MCAD Software
the ribbon shows the Sketch tab
the user opens the Create panel title context menu
the customization dialog opens on the "Ribbon" tab
the custom panel list is empty
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands
the right transfer button is enabled
the custom panel list remains empty
no command is added to the custom panel
the sketch remains in edit mode
